objective: glassy layered SDF grass, green neon, hilly golf course (VanguardGolfSDF_v1)
sourceSpace: right-handed-y-up (WebGL2 raymarch; +Y up, camera orbits about origin)

destinationSpaces.unity: native HLSL port renders in clip-space full-screen pass; SDF math kept in the same right-handed Y-up scene space
destinationSpaces.unreal: labeled native variant via Custom node; same scene space inside the shader body

children.name: TerrainSDF
children.detail: FBM hills (xz*0.085, 5 oct) + ridges (xz*0.22+17, 3 oct), amp lerp(0.55,2.35,uMorph); 3 putting-green depressions at (6.5,-3), (-5,4.5), (1.5,7); cup cylinder r=0.07 at green 1

children.name: GrassShells
children.detail: 3 Voronoi blade shells at layer 0.0/0.45/0.85; density lerp(9,16,layer); wind sway driven by uTime*uFlow; suppressed on greens

children.name: GlassFairway
children.detail: thin sheet abs(y-(h+0.03))-0.01 masked to fairway corridor, presence scaled by 0.35+uGlass*0.65

meshes: none — all geometry is shader-procedural SDF raymarched in the fragment shader (96 steps, hit eps 0.0015, far 55)

materials.name: turf/neon grass
materials.detail: albedo lerp(turf(0.04,0.28,0.08), neon(0.2,1.0,0.38)) by grass height and uHeat; VanguardUber 55-degree gradient contract (deep turf -> neon lime, strength 0.85, gain 2.2)

materials.name: glass
materials.detail: VanguardUber fresnel contract: pow(1-NdV, lerp(1.4,3.2,uGlass)) * (0.35+uGlass*1.4) * glassCol(0.55,1.0,0.75); specular exponent lerp(16,64,uGlass)

materials.name: emissive
materials.detail: neon * uHeat * pulse(sin(uTime*2.2+x*0.4)) * grassAmt * 0.35 (Uber emissive contract)

textures: none — fully procedural (Vanguard_Hash21/Hash22 value noise, FBM, 5x5 Voronoi F1/F2)
lights: single analytic directional light normalize(0.45,0.85,0.35) inside the shader; distance fog to (0.02,0.07,0.04); neon fog scaled by uHeat; vignette 1-0.22*|uv|^2; output gamma pow(col,0.92)
cameras: orbit rig only (see transformHierarchy); drag deltas yaw +0.005/px, pitch +0.004/px
animation: requestAnimationFrame loop; uTime = (performance.now()-t0)*0.001 seconds; wind, blade scroll, ripple, and emissive pulse all derive from uTime

uResolution.source: canvas size, devicePixelRatio capped at 2, set every frame

uPointer.range: NDC [-1,1], y inverted from client coords

uOrbit.content: (yaw radians unbounded, pitch radians clamped -0.55..0.85 in shader)

jsApi.setControl: (name in {morph,flow,heat,glass}, value) -> updates state + HUD slider
jsApi.getState: () -> { frames, pointerMoves, morph, flow, heat, glass, orbit, pointer, time }
